statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry (CPT 93229) was the service provided
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry is clinically indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to the symptomatic episodes
Prior authorization is required for this diagnostic procedure
